incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-TPL: private-vpc-controlplane-heartbeat-loss for customer AcmeCorp — paging #incidents and oncall
pagerduty: Trigger: PD-37891 — Priority: P1 — Symptoms: control-plane heartbeats missing from onprem agents in us-east-1. Links: <https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-37891>
sara: acked — I'm on it. pinging network team and CS for customer impact
mike: looking, grabbing logs from controlplane nodes
jordan: @sara what's the observed customer impact? Are API calls failing or just stale metrics?
sara: customers hitting 503/504 for management endpoints; some agents showing 'controlplane_unreachable' in agent logs. CS says AcmeCorp escalated via support. marking page P1 for now :rotating_light:
mike: grep on controlplane logs shows intermittent TLS handshake errors and ~60s gaps in agent heartbeats. suspect firewall rule applied in their VPC peering. running:
```
ssh controlplane-02
sudo journalctl -u controlplane | tail -n 80
# looks like TCP RSTs from 10.20.30.0/24
```
sara: can we pull flow logs / tcpdump at the border? @lee can you check VPC flow logs for AcmeCorp tenant?
lee: pulling flow logs now, pushing filtered to s3://redwood-debug/flowlogs/acmecorp/3861234567.log
jordan: root cause hypothesis: customer changed their IGW/NAT or applied a restrictive NACL — control plane's health check port (8443) being blocked. Customer confirmed they ran a config push ~5m before alert.
sara: asked customer to revert config; CS on call is coordinating. also starting temporary fallback: enable controlplane egress via transit-gateway route for AcmeCorp
mike: applying workaround — adding route via tg-rt-9 for tenant subnets (will take ~20s). patch applied, monitoring.
incident-bot: action executed: route add -> success
sara: after route change, agent heartbeats increasing, errors dropping. rolling back in 30m after customer confirms permanent fix. marking mitigation successful :thumbsup:
customer-success-bot: AcmeCorp (Primary contact: ana@acme) confirms they reverted the NACL change; reports management API latency normalized.
jordan: verify no regressions — running smoke test against control plane and onprem agent registration
```
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.example/internal/smoke -d '{"tenant":"acmecorp"}'
{"status":"ok","agents_registered":42}
```
sara: severity downgrade to P2; preparing handoff to @lee for the next 30m watch window. I'll write initial notes for postmortem.
lee: taking over monitoring, will escalate if error rate > 5% for >5m
sara: thanks team. closing pager and moving this thread to incidents doc. will open an action item: verify route filtering rules with AcmeCorp and add more graceful fallback to transit-gw routing.
mike: filing follow-up ticket IR-3861 to add detection for tenant NACL changes and automated reroute.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-37891 resolved by sara at 3861234689
sara: final note: root cause: customer-side NACL change blocking control plane port 8443; mitigation: temp transit-gateway route; next steps: postmortem + automation
